fields.Text: UML stands for {{c1::Unified Modeling Language}}: a standard set of notations for modelling object-oriented systems.

fields.Front: How do OO techniques view a software system?
fields.Back: As networks of communicating objects; each object is an instance of a class; objects of a class share attributes and methods; classes can be specialized by subclasses; objects communicate by sending messages.

fields.Front: List the five things an object may do in response to a message.
fields.Back: Update its internal state; return a value from its state; perform a calculation based on its state and return it; create a new object (or set of objects); delegate part or all of the task to another object.
